ucs.name: Receivables & DSO
ucs.method: Overdue customer bills, ageing and DSO.

ucs.name: Credit-limit breach
ucs.method: Customer exposure versus credit limit set in Tally.

ucs.name: Overdue + new dispatch
ucs.method: New sales invoice or delivery to a customer already overdue.

ucs.name: Duplicate invoice/payment
ucs.method: Same supplier bill booked twice, or the same payment made twice.

ucs.name: Early payment / DPO
ucs.method: Payments made well before the due date (fact only), and interest / penalties / late fees booked.

ucs.name: GST input credit (purchase register vs GSTR-2B)
ucs.method: Every purchase bill in Tally matched with the supplier-reported GSTR-2B, bill by bill, month by month.

ucs.name: PO - receipt note - bill 3-way match
ucs.method: Supplier bills checked item by item against the Purchase Order rate and the quantity received on the Receipt Note.

ucs.name: Customer invoice validation (rejection risk)
ucs.method: Sales invoices checked for what a customer rejects them for - GSTIN, tax type vs place of supply, rate vs sales order / price list.

ucs.name: Amazon marketplace reconciliation (Tally vs Seller Central)
ucs.method: Every Amazon order, refund, settlement, payout, fee, TCS / TDS credit, Amazon fee invoice and FBA stock movement checked against Tally.

ucs.name: Raw-material price variance
ucs.method: Item purchase rates compared with the item's own history and with other suppliers.

ucs.name: BOM-driven material reorder
ucs.method: Open sales orders exploded through the bill of materials against stock, open POs and reorder levels.

ucs.name: Excess / emergency purchasing
ucs.method: Purchases that push stock above the planned cover, and unplanned purchases without a PO at a premium.

ucs.name: Supplier performance scorecard
ucs.method: Each supplier scored on delivery, quality rejections and price movement.

ucs.name: Quality rejection and debit-note tracking
ucs.method: Rejections recorded at QC matched with the debit notes in Tally.

ucs.name: Job-work material tracking
ucs.method: Material sent to job workers (job-worker godowns) matched with returns and job-work bills.

ucs.name: Freight and landed-cost check
ucs.method: Freight bills checked against the transporter's rate card and the goods actually received.

ucs.name: TDS compliance (deduction, deposit, return)
ucs.method: TDS deducted on every payment that attracts it, deposited on time and reported in the return.

ucs.name: MSME 45-day payment compliance
ucs.method: Bills of micro / small suppliers paid or outstanding beyond the legal limit.

ucs.name: Vendor payment run proposal
ucs.method: A proposed payment list for the coming days, MSME and statutory first, holds and advances applied.

ucs.name: Supplier advances and excess payments
ucs.method: Advances not adjusted, payments above the bill and supplier ledgers in debit.

ucs.name: Vendor bank-detail change
ucs.method: Bank-detail changes on supplier masters followed by payments.

ucs.name: Duplicate / suspicious suppliers
ucs.method: Supplier masters with duplicate identities, missing KYC or links to employees / customers.

ucs.name: Purchase policy compliance
ucs.method: Bills split under the approval limit, purchases without a PO and POs raised after the bill.

ucs.name: Supplier statement reconciliation
ucs.method: Supplier statements of account compared with the supplier ledger.

ucs.name: Capex vs revenue classification
ucs.method: Asset purchases charged to expenses and running expenses charged to fixed assets.

ucs.name: Month-end close tracker
ucs.method: Close checklist status, with the status of checkable tasks read from the books and the other use cases.

ucs.name: Bank reconciliation
ucs.method: Bank ledger in Tally matched with the bank statement.

ucs.name: Production cost and yield variance
ucs.method: Material used per production batch vs the BOM; scrap vs norm; price variance vs standard cost.

ucs.name: WIP valuation
ucs.method: Work in progress per the shop-floor register vs the WIP held in the books.

ucs.name: Inventory valuation and NRV
ucs.method: Stock valued above net realisable value, non-moving and slow-moving stock.

ucs.name: Physical vs book stock
ucs.method: The physical count sheet compared with book stock by item and godown.

ucs.name: Overhead absorption
ucs.method: Factory overheads incurred vs overheads absorbed into production.

ucs.name: Period-end cut-off - accruals, provisions and prepaids
ucs.method: Recurring expenses missing for the period, goods received not billed, and annual payments charged fully to expense.

ucs.name: Fixed asset register and depreciation
ucs.method: The fixed asset register compared with the books: additions, disposals and depreciation booked.

ucs.name: Suspense and clearing accounts
ucs.method: Open items in suspense / clearing ledgers.

ucs.name: Journal and ledger review
ucs.method: Manual journals with risk patterns, and ledgers with the wrong balance nature.

ucs.name: GST output three-way reconciliation
ucs.method: Books vs GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B: output tax and input credit by month.

ucs.name: Payroll and statutory dues
ucs.method: Payroll register vs salary bookings; PF / ESI deducted vs deposited and on time.

ucs.name: Budget vs actual
ucs.method: Actual expenses by ledger and month against the budget.

ucs.name: Cash flow and working-capital forecast
ucs.method: 13-week cash forecast from due dates, open orders and recurring / statutory payments.

ucs.name: Audit and tax-audit preparation
ucs.method: A year-to-date audit pack: tax-audit data points from the other use cases and the documents still missing.
